title: Webb’s mysterious little red dots may be hiding entire galaxies

When the team simulated what the Saguaro would look like much farther away, its spiral structure essentially vanished, leaving only the bright red core.

title: Scientists reveal why walking gets so much harder with age

This leads to shorter strides, slower walking, and faster fatigue. Exercises targeting balance, coordination, and lower-leg strength could help preserve mobility.

title: A new Ice Age species was hiding in la brea tar pits fossils for decades

title: A black hole shredded a “super sun” — but something strange may have survived

Months later, scientists spotted unexpectedly fast-moving helium, suggesting that some structure may have survived the destruction.
